towns.name: Nagercoil
towns.title: Self Drive Car & Bike Rental in Nagercoil
towns.description: Self drive cars, bikes and wedding cars in Nagercoil. Delivery anywhere in town, clear KM limits and a deposit you get back. Call +91 63749 42976.
towns.knownFor: the district headquarters, and where our vehicles are kept
towns.intro: Nagercoil is where we are based, so this is the quickest place in the district to get a vehicle. If you are at the railway junction, the bus stand, a hotel in town or your own front door, we can usually have something with you the same day, and often within the hour.
towns.local: The town is built around the Nagaraja temple, and traffic through the centre is heavy for most of the day. Anyone driving here for the first time is better off taking the bypass rather than the old town roads, and parking near the market is easier before ten in the morning.
landmarks: Nagaraja Temple, in the centre of town
Nagercoil Junction, on the Thiruvananthapuram line
The Vadasery bus stand, for connections across the district

trips.note: For sunrise, the Vivekananda Rock and the Thiruvalluvar statue
The Thanumalayan temple, a short run out of town
A hill walk, best early in the day

towns.name: Kanyakumari
towns.title: Car & Bike Rental in Kanyakumari — Self Drive Hire
towns.description: Self drive car and bike hire in Kanyakumari. Delivered to your hotel near the beach or the ferry. Daily and weekly rates, clear KM limits, refundable deposit.
towns.knownFor: the southern tip of the mainland, and the reason most visitors come to the district
towns.intro: Almost everyone who hires a vehicle in Kanyakumari is staying a night or two and wants to see more than the tip itself. A car for a day covers the temples inland and the coast road west, which no tour bus timetable will give you, and a two wheeler is the easier thing for getting around the town itself.
towns.local: The streets around the ferry and the beach are narrow and busy from before dawn, because the sunrise crowd starts early. Parking is far easier a few streets back from the seafront, and we can deliver to any of the hotels along the main road rather than meeting in the middle of that.
landmarks: The Vivekananda Rock Memorial, reached by ferry
The Thiruvalluvar Statue on the neighbouring rock
Bhagavathy Amman Temple, by the shore
The sunrise and sunset points, at opposite ends of the same beach

trips.note: The Thanumalayan temple, on the road back towards Nagercoil
The wooden palace of the old Travancore capital
West along the coast, for a quieter beach and the harbour

towns.name: Marthandam
towns.title: Self Drive Car Rental in Marthandam, Kanyakumari
towns.description: Self drive cars and bikes delivered in Marthandam. Monthly hire for work postings, wedding cars for the season, and airport runs to Trivandrum.
towns.knownFor: the trading town of the rubber belt, on the highway towards Thiruvananthapuram
towns.intro: Marthandam sits on the main road north-west, which makes it the part of the district where a car is most often hired for a month rather than a day. Families working in Thiruvananthapuram, people back from the Gulf for a few weeks, and anyone who has to make the Trivandrum airport run more than once — that is most of what we deliver here.
towns.local: Being on the highway cuts both ways: getting out of Marthandam towards Kerala is quick, and getting across the town at market time is not. The rubber estates on either side of the road mean the side roads are narrow and shaded, and they are worth taking slowly after rain.
landmarks: The market, busiest early in the week
The rubber estates that surround the town
The NH-66 junction, the fast way to Thiruvananthapuram

trips.note: The run most of our monthly hires here are for
Close enough to do in a morning
Further up the same highway

towns.name: Colachel
towns.title: Car & Bike Rental in Colachel — Self Drive Hire
towns.description: Self drive cars and two wheelers delivered in Colachel. Coastal runs, family trips and monthly hire across the west of Kanyakumari district.
towns.knownFor: a fishing harbour on the west coast, and the battle fought here in 1741
towns.intro: Colachel is a working harbour town rather than a tourist one, and the hires here are mostly practical: getting a family to a wedding inland, a month's use while a car is off the road, or a day out along the coast. The beach north of the harbour is quiet on a weekday in a way that Kanyakumari never is.
towns.local: The road along the coast is narrow in places and shared with fishing traffic early in the morning, so nobody in a hurry should take it at six. The inland road to Nagercoil is the faster of the two and the one we normally suggest.
landmarks: The fishing harbour and the boats coming in
The 1741 battle memorial, from the Travancore victory over the Dutch
The beach north of the harbour, quiet on weekdays

trips.note: The inland road, quicker than the coast
North, through the plantation country
The long way round the coast, worth it once

towns.name: Thuckalay
towns.title: Self Drive Car Rental in Thuckalay, Kanyakumari
towns.description: Self drive cars, bikes and tourist vehicles delivered in Thuckalay. Minutes from Padmanabhapuram Palace, on the Nagercoil–Thiruvananthapuram road.
towns.knownFor: the town beside Padmanabhapuram, on the road between Nagercoil and Kerala
towns.intro: Thuckalay is close enough to Nagercoil for a same-day delivery and far enough along the Kerala road to be a sensible place to start a drive north. It is also the nearest town to Padmanabhapuram Palace, so a fair number of the day hires here are people who want the palace without the coach party.
towns.local: The main road through Thuckalay carries the traffic between Nagercoil and Thiruvananthapuram, which makes it slow through the middle of the day and clear early. The roads towards the palace and the villages behind it are quieter and well surfaced.
landmarks: Padmanabhapuram Palace, a short drive away
The Nagercoil–Thiruvananthapuram highway through the town
The paddy country on the roads behind the town

trips.note: Near enough to walk, easier to park a car nearby
The Adikesava Perumal temple, north on a quiet road
Twenty minutes when the road is clear

towns.name: Kuzhithurai
towns.title: Car & Bike Rental in Kuzhithurai — Self Drive Hire
towns.description: Self drive cars and bikes delivered in Kuzhithurai. Monthly rates, Trivandrum airport runs and wedding cars across the north-west of the district.
towns.knownFor: the last town of any size before the Kerala border
towns.intro: Kuzhithurai is closer to Thiruvananthapuram than to Nagercoil, and the hires reflect it — airport runs, monthly cars for people working across the border, and vehicles for families who live here and travel the other way. We deliver this far out; it is worth telling us the day before rather than the morning of.
towns.local: The highway through Kuzhithurai is the quick route into Kerala, and the crossing is straightforward. Anyone planning to drive across should tell us, because the paperwork we hand over matters more once you are out of Tamil Nadu.
landmarks: The NH-66 crossing towards Kerala
The rubber and plantation country on both sides of the town
The weekly market

trips.note: Under an hour and a half in ordinary traffic
The next town down the highway
East, towards the temple and the river

towns.name: Padmanabhapuram
towns.title: Car Rental in Padmanabhapuram — Self Drive Hire
towns.description: Self drive car and bike hire in Padmanabhapuram. See the palace in your own time, then drive the rest of the district without a tour timetable.
towns.knownFor: the wooden palace of the old Travancore capital
towns.intro: Most people come to Padmanabhapuram for the palace, and most of them see it as one stop on somebody else's timetable. A car for the day is the difference between forty minutes in the palace and a morning in it, with the rest of the day for the temples and the coast rather than a coach back.
towns.local: The palace closes for a long lunch and on Mondays, which catches out a lot of visitors — worth checking before setting off. Parking near the entrance fills by mid-morning in season, and there is more of it a short walk back towards Thuckalay.
landmarks: Padmanabhapuram Palace, the largest wooden palace complex in Asia
The old fort walls around the palace
Thuckalay town, a few minutes away

trips.note: The Adikesava Perumal temple, on the river
South to the coast and the harbour
Back towards the district town

towns.name: Suchindram
towns.title: Car & Bike Rental in Suchindram, Kanyakumari
towns.description: Self drive cars and two wheelers delivered in Suchindram. Minutes from Nagercoil, on the road to Kanyakumari. Clear KM limits and a refundable deposit.
towns.knownFor: the Thanumalayan temple, and its musical pillars
towns.intro: Suchindram is close enough to Nagercoil that delivery here is quick and the same-day answer is almost always yes. It sits on the road between Nagercoil and Kanyakumari, which makes it a natural first or last stop on a day out rather than a trip of its own.
towns.local: The temple street is narrow and the crowd builds around the main pooja times, so a car is better left at the edge of it. A two wheeler is genuinely easier here, and a good number of our hires in Suchindram are exactly that.
landmarks: Thanumalayan Temple, with its carved musical pillars
The Hanuman statue inside the temple, one of the tallest of its kind
The temple tank

trips.note: Straight on down the same road
Ten minutes back into town
The hill, for a morning walk

towns.name: Thiruvattar
towns.title: Self Drive Car Rental in Thiruvattar, Kanyakumari
towns.description: Self drive cars and bikes delivered in Thiruvattar. For the Adikesava Perumal temple, the river road, and getting around the north of the district.
towns.knownFor: the Adikesava Perumal temple, on an island between two rivers
towns.intro: Thiruvattar is inland and north, in the quieter part of the district, and public transport out of it is thin enough that a vehicle changes what a day can hold. People hire here to reach the temple without a bus timetable, and to get across to Padmanabhapuram and the coast in the same trip.
towns.local: The roads north of the town run through plantation and paddy country and are pleasant driving, but they are narrow and unlit after dark. Anyone heading back to Nagercoil in the evening is better off leaving before the light goes.
landmarks: Adikesava Perumal Temple, between the Kothai and Paraliyar rivers
The river and the paddy fields around the town
The plantation roads running north towards the hills

trips.note: South, an easy half day
West, towards the highway
Back to the district town

towns.name: Eraniel
towns.title: Car & Bike Rental in Eraniel — Self Drive Hire
towns.description: Self drive cars and two wheelers delivered in Eraniel. Between Nagercoil and the coast, with clear KM limits and a deposit you get back.
towns.knownFor: a small town in the paddy country between Nagercoil and the coast
towns.intro: Eraniel is a short delivery from our base and sits between the district town and the western coast, which makes it a practical place to start a drive in either direction. Most of the hires here are family ones — a wedding, a temple visit, a week while a car is in the workshop.
towns.local: The roads around Eraniel run between paddy fields and are narrow, level and easy driving, which makes them a gentle place to get used to an unfamiliar car before joining the main road.
landmarks: The paddy country around the town
The road west towards Colachel and the sea
Padmanabhapuram, a short drive north

trips.note: North, easily done in a morning
West to the harbour and the beach
East into town

towns.name: Boothapandi
towns.title: Self Drive Car Rental in Boothapandi, Kanyakumari
towns.description: Self drive cars and bikes delivered in Boothapandi. On the Nagercoil–Tirunelveli road, with daily, weekly and monthly rates.
towns.knownFor: the town on the Pazhayar, on the road north towards Tirunelveli
towns.intro: Boothapandi is a quick delivery from Nagercoil and sits on the road heading north-east, which is the way out of the district towards Tirunelveli and Madurai. A fair share of the hires here are for exactly that — a run north and back over two or three days.
towns.local: The road north climbs gradually and the wind through the gap is strong enough to be felt in a small car, particularly in the afternoon. It is a well surfaced road and an easy drive; the wind is simply worth knowing about before you meet it.
landmarks: The Pazhayar river crossing
The road north towards Tirunelveli and the wind farms
The paddy country south of the town

trips.note: Fifteen minutes back into town
North through the gap, the main road out of the district
South, past Nagercoil

towns.name: Azhagiapandipuram
towns.title: Car & Bike Rental in Azhagiapandipuram — Self Drive
towns.description: Self drive cars and two wheelers delivered in Azhagiapandipuram, near Thuckalay and Padmanabhapuram. Daily, weekly and monthly rates.
towns.knownFor: a town in the Kalkulam country, close to Thuckalay and the palace
towns.intro: Azhagiapandipuram is a residential town rather than a stop on anyone's itinerary, and the hires here are the everyday kind: a month's car between vehicles, something for a family occasion, a bike for a few days. We deliver to the door rather than asking anyone to come to Nagercoil for it.
towns.local: The town is a few minutes off the main Nagercoil–Thiruvananthapuram road, so getting onto the highway is quick without living on it. The lanes within the town are narrow, which is worth a thought if you are choosing between a hatchback and a seven seater.
landmarks: Thuckalay, a few minutes away
Padmanabhapuram Palace, a short drive
The plantation and paddy country around the town

trips.note: Close enough for an unhurried morning
Back down the main road
South-west to the coast
